$comment: What Tom extracts from a freight / customs / haulage website. Knight may only use these facts.

fields.label: Named director or contact person, if stated
Office hours, one line per day range
Services they list (e.g. sea freight, air freight, road haulage, customs clearance, warehousing), in their words
Routes, lanes, ports or countries they say they serve (only as stated)
Accreditations, memberships or registrations exactly as the site states them (never infer any)
Other practical details: depot facilities, languages, cut-off times (only if stated)
